items.computation: The letter states a fixed appointment date and time: Wednesday, 22.04.2026 at 08:15. No period calculation is needed; the date is printed directly and 22.04.2026 does fall on a Wednesday as stated. This is an appointment obligation under § 59 SGB II i.V.m. § 309 SGB III (Meldeaufforderung); the person must physically attend at this date and time.

warnings: This is a Meldeaufforderung (reporting requirement), not a formal administrative act with a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung; the letter warns that unexcused non-attendance (without a 'wichtiger Grund') will reduce Bürgergeld by 10% of the standard needs rate for one month (§ 32 SGB II) — if you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter before the appointment to explain and reschedule.
